_comment: Curated FireRed (BPRE0) obtain methods that CANNOT be extracted from script data, because the species are baked into an ASM 'special' (Fighting Dojo) or given from a menu jump-table script the top-level walk can't reach (Game Corner), or are roaming/event encounters set up in code. Everything else in the dump is auto-derived from tables + reachable scripts; this file only fills the verified blind spots. Levels are omitted where they live in ASM and can't be read from the ROM.

fightingDojo.note: After defeating the Karate Master, take ONE of the two Poke Balls. Species are ASM-hardcoded (no literal givePokemon/setvar in the ROM).

gameCorner.note: Bought with coins from the Pokemon prize clerk (vendor script @ 0x16CB88; the give sits in a menu jump-table the standard script walk can't reach). The dump now reads the species + costs LIVE from the ROM via the export_coin_prizes MCP tool (scripts.text.multichoice options, e.g. text 'PORYGON 9,999 COINS') - so an edited ROM reports its own prizes. The list below is only a fallback for when that tool's output is absent. SCYTHER is the FireRed prize (LeafGreen swaps in PINSIR).
gameCorner.costSource: export_coin_prizes tool reads scripts.text.multichoice option text '<SPECIES> <n> COINS' (vanilla FireRed: options @ 0x3E01C8)

roaming.note: Post-National-Dex: exactly ONE legendary beast roams Kanto, determined by your starter choice. Set up in code, not in the wild table.

eventTicket.note: Reachable in-game only with an event-distributed ticket item. MEW / CELEBI / JIRACHI were distribution-only (no in-game route) and are left unobtainable.
